# New Disney+ Pricing: What You'll Pay and How Much More

By WDWMAGIC Staff· Wednesday September 23, 2026 12:44pm ET·"Disney+"

 View 3 photos

WDWMAGIC+

 Disney+ prices have risen across most plans as of September 23, 2026. Premium tiers jumped 13.2%, while existing subscribers keep their current rate until October 21, 2026.

 Disney+ prices have risen across most plans as of September 23, 2026. Premium tiers jumped 13.2%, while existing subscribers keep their current rate until October 21, 2026. 

Photos / 3 in this gallery

 

Disney has raised prices on several Disney+ and bundle subscription plans. 

The Disney+ price increase applies to new subscriptions starting today, September 23, 2026. If you already have a Disney+ subscription, the new pricing will show up in your billing cycle on or after October 21, 2026.

Disney+

### New Disney+ Pricing and Percentage Increases

Here's what changed, including how much each plan went up by percentage:

- Disney+ (With Ads): $12.49, up from $11.99 — a 4.2% increase
- Disney+ Premium Monthly (No Ads): $21.49, up from $18.99 — a 13.2% increase
- Disney+ Premium Annual (No Ads): $214.99, up from $189.99 — a 13.2% increase
- Disney+, Hulu Bundle Premium (No Ads): $21.99, up from $19.99 — a 10% increase
- Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (With Ads): $21.99, up from $19.99 — a 10% increase
- Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (No Ads): $34.99, up from $32.99 — a 6.1% increase

The Premium plans, both monthly and annual, saw the largest percentage jump at over 13%. The ad-supported Disney+ plan had the smallest increase, at just over 4%.

### When You'll See the Change

New subscribers pay the updated prices right away. If you're a current subscriber, your rate stays the same until your next billing cycle on or after October 21, 2026. Check your account settings for your exact renewal date so you know when the new price takes effect.

# How Much Does Disney+ Cost?

Disney+ costs $12.49 a month for an ad-based subscription or $21.49 a month for an ad-free experience.

Written by

Lisa Mulka

Lisa Mulka

Contributing Writer

Co-written by

Tommy Tindall

Tommy Tindall

Lead Writer & Content Strategist

19 years of experience

Expertise

- Making money
- Saving money
- Budgeting
- Shopping

Tommy Tindall is a lead writer and content strategist covering how to make money — and how to keep it. He’s recorded and written about his experience testing popular gig jobs like driving for Uber, delivering with DoorDash and full-service shopping for Instacart. He loves making an extra buck, but laments the hours of awkward silence he endured as an Uber driver (never again).

Cool kids might call him a content creator because he makes YouTube videos for the NerdWallet channel and app, but he himself is no longer very cool. Ask him about budgeting apps — he's tried most of them, but still prefers a good ole Google sheet to track spending. Then be sure to smash that “like” and “subscribe” button.

Before NerdWallet, Tommy held decidedly more boring jobs at Fannie Mae and Booz Allen Hamilton. Today, he feels super privileged to write for you, the consumer.

Edited by

Courtney Neidel

Courtney Neidel

Managing Editor

12 years of experience

Courtney Neidel is an assigning editor for the core personal finance team at NerdWallet. She joined NerdWallet in 2014 and spent six years writing about shopping, budgeting and money-saving strategies before being promoted to editor. Courtney has been interviewed as a retail authority by "Good Morning America," Cheddar and CBSN. Her prior experience includes freelance writing for California newspapers.

Updated Sep 24, 2026

How is this page expert verified?

NerdWallet's content is fact-checked for accuracy, timeliness and relevance. It undergoes a thorough review process involving writers and editors to ensure the information is as clear and complete as possible.

Disney’s popular streaming service offers a robust library. It ranges from classic animated films and exclusive Marvel content like the new "Wonder Man" series to hit shows like "The Simpsons." 

But just how much does Disney+ cost? It starts at $12.49 a month. 

## How much does a Disney+ subscription cost per month?

The final cost of Disney+ depends on whether you’re willing to put up with ads. 

The ad-supported plan is $12.49 a month. The ad-free Premium plan costs $21.49 a month or $214.99 a year.

That said, Disney+ offers some of the most flexible package deals of any streaming platform. Users can bundle Disney+ with other streaming services for enhanced savings and a larger content menu. Packages include:

- Disney+ (with ads) and Hulu (with ads): $12.99 a month. 
- Disney+ (with ads), Hulu (with ads) and ESPN Select (with ads): $21.99 a month. 
- Disney+ (ad-free) and Hulu (ad-free): $21.99 a month. 
- Disney+ (ad-free), Hulu (ad-free) and ESPN Select (with ads): $32.99 a month.

Some existing subscribers have the “legacy” bundle for $27.99 a month, which combines Disney+ (ad-free), Hulu (with ads) and ESPN Select (with ads). This plan is no longer available for new subscribers.

This tool was created with the assistance of AI. It has been reviewed by our editorial team for accuracy and quality.

## What does Disney+ include?

The ad-supported version of Disney+ includes:

- Disney movies and TV series.
- Star Wars and Marvel content.
- 4K playback (on select titles).
- The ability to stream up to four devices simultaneously.
- A total of seven user profiles.

In addition to ad-free streaming, the premium version also offers:

- Unlimited downloads on up to 10 devices.
- Dolby Atmos sound (on select titles).

## Does Disney+ allow password sharing?

Disney does not allow sharing of accounts or subscriptions outside of a single household, which it defines as devices that are linked to your personal primary residence.

Published Oct 11, 2026 Checked against official sources · last verified Oct 11, 2026 · how we verify

Disney+ has two plans of its own and nine more that wrap it with Hulu, ESPN, HBO Max or NFL+. # Disney+ Price Increase Hits October 21: Why the $21.99 Hulu Bundle Beats $21.49 Premium, and How to Switch or Cancel First (2026)

 By Jordan Lee October 12, 2026 October 12, 2026 

Short answer: Existing Disney+ subscribers pay the new prices from their first bill on or after October 21, 2026. Premium goes from $18.99 to $21.49 a month. The plan with ads goes from $11.99 to $12.49. Here’s the odd part: the Disney+ and Hulu Premium bundle is $21.99, just 50 cents more than Disney+ Premium alone. The Disney+ and Hulu bundle with ads didn’t change at $12.99. If you pay for Premium by itself, the bundle or the ad tier is almost always the better deal now.

A $2.50 bump doesn’t sound like much. Over a year it’s $30, and Disney has now raised Disney+ prices roughly once a year since launch.

But the more interesting change isn’t the hike itself. Disney priced its plans so that Disney+ Premium on its own now looks like a bad deal next to the bundle. Once you see the numbers side by side, the “what should I do before October 21” question mostly answers itself.

Below is every new price, the plan math for the three most common situations, and how to switch or cancel cleanly before your renewal date.

## In This Comparison

- When does the Disney+ price increase hit existing subscribers?
- How much does each Disney+ plan cost now?
- Is the Disney+ and Hulu bundle cheaper than Disney+ Premium alone?
- Should you switch to the annual plan?
- How do I switch plans or cancel before my renewal?
- Picking the Cheapest Plan for How You Actually Watch
- Tips
- Warnings
- FAQ
- Sources

## When does the Disney+ price increase hit existing subscribers?

Existing U.S. Disney+ subscribers are charged the new prices starting with their first billing date on or after October 21, 2026, while new subscribers have paid the higher rates since September 23, 2026, according to Disney’s announcement as reported by CBS News on September 23, 2026.

So the exact day depends on your billing date. If you’re billed on the 5th, your first higher charge lands November 5. If you’re billed on the 22nd, it lands October 22.

That’s useful. Most people have a week or more to decide.

## How much does each Disney+ plan cost now?

As of October 2026, Disney+ Premium costs $21.49 a month and Disney+ with ads costs $12.49 a month in the U.S., up from $18.99 and $11.99, while the Disney+ and Hulu bundle with ads stays at $12.99 a month, per Disney’s figures reported by CBS News and Variety.

| Plan (U.S., monthly) | Old price | New price | Change per year |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Disney+ with ads | $11.99 | $12.49 | +$6.00 |
| Disney+ Premium (no ads) | $18.99 | $21.49 | +$30.00 |
| Disney+ and Hulu bundle (with ads) | $12.99 | $12.99 | $0 |
| Disney+ and Hulu bundle Premium | $19.99 | $21.99 | +$24.00 |

Prices from Disney’s September 23, 2026 announcement as reported by CBS News and Variety. Yearly change is our calculation (monthly difference × 12), before tax.

## Is the Disney+ and Hulu bundle cheaper than Disney+ Premium alone?

The Disney+ and Hulu Premium bundle costs $21.99 a month after the October 2026 increase, only $0.50 more than Disney+ Premium alone at $21.49, so anyone paying for ad-free Disney+ by itself can add ad-free Hulu for 50 cents.

When I compared the old and new tables, I found that the gap used to be bigger in the other direction. Under the old prices, the Premium bundle cost $1.00 more than Disney+ Premium alone ($19.99 vs $18.99). Now it’s half that.

# Disney+ price: how much does it cost, are there any deals, is it cheaper than Netflix, and more

 By Tom Power 

 Last updated 7 July 2026 

TechRadar tells you everything you need to know about the cost of Disney+

 Disney+ is one of the more expensive streamers to sign up to (Image credit: Ivan Marc/Shutterstock) 

- Prices at a glance 
- Current offers 
- US price 
- International price 
- Price comparison 

Whether you're a new or returning customer, I've put in the hard yards and rounded up the most important details on those aforementioned prices — and if there's a way to save some cash if you take the plunge.

- US: Subscribe to Disney+ from $11.99 per month
- UK: Subscribe to Disney+ from £5.99 per month
- Australia: Subscribe to Disney+ from AU$9.99 per month

So, what are you waiting for? Read to learn more one of the best streaming services' various price points, what features each tier comes packaged with, how Disney+ compares to its rivals from a cost standpoint, and so much more!

## Disney+ price: the basics

Disney+ is home to some of the world's biggest franchises, including Star Wars and Marvel (Image credit: Disney)

After its initial launch in the US almost seven years ago, the price of Disney+ has only in one direction: up.

As of July 2026, those in the US have to spend $11.99 per month for its ad-supported plan and $15.99 every 30 days for the ad-free tier. You're looking at $189.99 for an annual subscription for the latter experience, too.

In the UK, an ad-based subscription costs £5.99 a month, the standard ad-free tier is £9.99 per month, and the ad-free premium plan will set you back £14.99 per month. Annually, the ad-free tiers are £99.90 and £149.90 respectively.

As for the rest of the world, here's how much a monthly subscription to Disney+'s ad-supported tier will set you back:

## Disney+ deals: are there any available?

The Mandalorian and Grogu won't land on Disney+ for some time yet (Image credit: Lucasfilm)

Not in the traditional sense. There is a way to save money, but you'll have take advantage of the Disney+ password sharing crackdown to do so.

Don't know what that is? Let me explain: in 2024, Disney began cracking down on account sharing. Essentially, that means you can no longer access the account of anyone who lives in a separate household to you, and vice versa. Family members and/or friends who wish to continue using your account — or, again, vice versa — needed to be added to an existing subscription as an Extra Member.

You can't do that for free, either. In the US, an additional $6.99 (with ads) and $9.99 (without ads) per month is needed to add a Extra Member to someone's account. Meanwhile, those in the UK need to fork out £4.99 for the ad-supported tier, or £5.99 every 30 days for the ad-free offerings.

Okay, but how can this save you some money? if you split the cost of a monthly subscription between everyone who wants to use the same account, you'll not only share the financial burden, but also keep some cash in your back pocket. Instead of paying $9.99 a month for the ad-free tier, then, two of you can spend just $4.98 every 30 days simply by adding the other person to one of your existing accounts. Simple!

## How much does Disney+ cost in the US?

The Bear's fifth and final season is out now on Hulu (US) and Disney+ (internationally) (Image credit: FX Networks)

# Disney+ Plans and Pricing: Which U.S. Subscription Is Best in 2026?

A dated U.S. guide to Disney+ prices, standalone plans, Hulu, ESPN, HBO Max and NFL+ bundles, annual billing, Extra Member eligibility and switching problems.

 Opened 01 OCT 2026 Runtime 6 min Written by DocumentaryTube Team 

Seat G4

U.S. price check: August 16, 2026. The cheapest standalone Disney+ plan is $11.99 per month with ads. If you also want Hulu, the Disney+, Hulu Bundle with Ads costs $12.99 per month—just $1 more. Disney+ Premium costs $18.99 monthly or $189.99 annually. Prices, availability and billing treatment can vary by country, promotion, billing partner and legacy subscription status.

## Quick answer

- Cheapest Disney+ alone: Disney+ with Ads, $11.99/month.
- Cheapest Disney+ and Hulu: Disney+, Hulu Bundle with Ads, $12.99/month.
- Cheapest ad-free Disney+: Disney+ Premium, $18.99/month.
- Best annual value: Disney+ Premium at $189.99/year, equivalent to about $15.83/month when paid upfront.
- Cheapest three-service bundle: Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Select Bundle with Ads, $19.99/month.
- Free trial: Disney says it does not currently offer one.

These are standard U.S. prices checked August 16, 2026, before taxes. Confirm the final checkout total, especially when subscribing through an app store, telecom provider or another third party.

### Standalone subscriptions

| Plan | Price | Advertising and features |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Disney+ with Ads | $11.99/month | Ads; up to 4K UHD/HDR, up to 5.1 audio and simultaneous streaming on multiple devices. |
| Disney+ Premium | $18.99/month or $189.99/year | No standard on-demand ads; up to 4K UHD/HDR, up to Dolby Atmos, simultaneous streaming on multiple devices and downloads on up to 10 devices. |

“Up to” 4K, HDR and Dolby Atmos depends on the title, device, connection and content availability. Premium removes standard on-demand advertising, but Disney says ads can still occur in selected live or linear programming and in promotional or sponsored content. The annual Premium price saves $37.89 versus 12 monthly payments, provided you keep the subscription for a full year.

### Disney+ and Hulu

| Disney+, Hulu Bundle Premium | $19.99/month | Disney+ Premium and Hulu Premium. |

Each bundle is $1 more than the equivalent standalone Disney+ plan. That makes the ad-supported bundle compelling if you will use Hulu; it is not a saving if Hulu would sit unused.

ESPN Select is the lower sports tier. Check the events, networks and blackout rules you need before subscribing; it is not interchangeable with ESPN Unlimited.
